evals.name: extend-not-replace
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, user sets <CompileDependsOn>MyTarget</CompileDependsOn>. Review.
evals.expected_output: It replaces the chain; append existing value.
assertions: Says assignment replaces the SDK chain.

evals.name: returns
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, explain Outputs vs Returns.
evals.expected_output: Outputs drives incrementality; Returns defines the item result.

evals.name: hook-choice
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, pick DependsOnTargets or AfterTargets.
evals.expected_output: DependsOnTargets for required prerequisites; AfterTargets for hooks.
assertions: Picks by ownership of the target.
